title: Vessel3D: ship models you can build on
summary: A Three.js-based library and live editor for conceptual ship visualization and basic naval architecture calculations.
contribution: Authored Vessel3D with NTNU / ShipLab support, building on the groundwork of Vessel.js. Developed the live editor and contributed ship interaction and stability features.
image_caption: The Vessel3D live editor, captured from the public source at commit 43adb48 using its default model.
